    • Winfree model winfree: The Winfree model, theta_i' = omega_i + (K / N) sum_j P(theta_j) R(theta_i), with the sum over all j.

    physics/waves

    • Lattice Maxwell and gauge link fields lattice_gauge_fields: Link variables on the cell complex of a periodic lattice, sampled or evolved in real time.
    • Schrödinger equation as real and imaginary fields schrodinger: A Gaussian wave packet that follows the Schrödinger equation, as its real and imaginary parts.
    • Schrödinger equation minimally coupled to an electromagnetic potential charged_schrodinger: A Gaussian wave packet of a charge in a prescribed electromagnetic potential, after Schwichtenberg 4.3.
    • Spring chains and guitar string spring_chain: Masses joined in a row by springs of zero rest length between two anchors, a discrete string.
    • Standing waves on a string standing_waves: A string with fixed ends on [-length / 2, length / 2] that vibrates as a standing wave.

    social/cooperation

    • Iterated prisoner's dilemma tournament prisoners_dilemma_tournament: The evolution of strategies of the iterated prisoner's dilemma from random genomes.
    • Public goods game public_goods_game: The spatial public goods game in groups of five neighbours, with Fermi imitation.
    • Public goods game on hypergraphs hypergraph_public_goods: The public goods game on a hypergraph, played in every hyperedge, with Fermi imitation.
    • Spatial prisoner's dilemma with best-neighbour and Fermi imitation spatial_prisoners_dilemma: The spatial prisoner's dilemma of Nowak and May, with best-neighbour or Fermi imitation.
    • Two-player games on links and three-body games on 2-simplices simplicial_social_dilemmas: The social dilemmas of Guo et al. on the links and the 2-simplices of a simplicial complex.

    social/crowds

    • Criminality and security criminality: The kinetic model of criminality in a society and the security forces that act against it.
    • Crowd dynamics and evacuation evacuation: The kinetic model of the evacuation of a building whose rooms form a network.
    • Social force pedestrians social_force: Two crowds walking in opposite directions along a periodic corridor, which form lanes.

    social/language

    • Mandelbrot least-effort word frequencies mandelbrot_least_effort: The word frequencies that minimise the mean cost of a language over its entropy, a power law of rank.

    social/opinion_dynamics

    • Axelrod culture dissemination axelrod: Axelrod's culture dissemination model on a full grid with von Neumann neighbourhoods.
    • Belief diffusion with influentials influentials: The belief diffusion model with influentials who care passionately and weigh more with their neighbours.
    • Coevolving voter coevolving_voter: The coevolving voter model, which fragments into consensual components when rewiring is fast.
    • Cognitive consistency agents cognitive_consistency: Agents whose attitudes spread by conversation and settle in a belief network that seeks consistency.
    • Complex agents with internal states and standardization standardized_agents: Complex agents whose interactions make them standardized, all showing one characteristic, and ordered.
    • Deffuant bounded confidence deffuant: The Deffuant bounded confidence model, whose opinions settle into about 1 / (2 * confidence) clusters.
    • Galam majority galam_majority: The Galam majority model, where random groups adopt their majority until one opinion wins.
    • Gauge theory of agents on a network gauge_network_agents: Agent phases on the nodes of a network that relax towards the transported phases of their neighbours.
    • Hegselmann-Krause hegselmann_krause: The Hegselmann-Krause model, whose opinions freeze within a few steps into clusters about 2 ε apart.
    • Join-a-club spins join_a_club: Join-a-club spins, agents who join a club with their acquaintances while acquaintances follow the club.
    • Kinetic opinion formation kinetic_opinion: The kinetic model of opinion formation over a discrete grid of opinions.
    • Majority rule automaton majority_rule: Voters that take the majority opinion of their neighbourhood, which coarsens into domains.
    • Naming game naming_game: The minimal naming game, where agents with empty inventories agree on one word.
    • Nonlinear three-body consensus on temporal hypergraphs hypergraph_consensus: The nonlinear three-body consensus model on a random hypergraph of triangles that switch on and off.
    • Social impact theory social_impact: The social impact model on a full grid, with random persuasiveness and supportiveness.
    • Sznajd sznajd: The Sznajd model, where agreeing pairs of agents convince their neighbours.
    • Threshold adoption threshold_adoption: The threshold adoption model in social circles, started by the 2.5% of agents with the lowest thresholds.
    • Voter model voter_model: A voter model with one voter per node of a network.
    • Voter variants voter_variants: Voter model variants on a network, with threshold voters and a share of contrarians.

    social/organizations

    • Barabási priority queues priority_queues: The Barabási priority queue, whose waiting times follow a power law as the choice becomes greedy.
    • Bonabeau hierarchies bonabeau_hierarchies: The Bonabeau model, where a hierarchy of strengths emerges above a critical density of agents.
    • Brothel movement model trafficking: The brothel movement model, where victims moved between brothels leave traces in bills and train trips.
    • Employment takeover employment_takeover: The employment takeover model on a periodic checkerboard, with half of each kind coloured at random.
    • Escalation escalation: Meadows' escalation trap, two parties that each want to exceed the other's stock by a margin.
    • Gravity interaction model of urban scaling gravity_urban_scaling: The residents of a city at uniform positions in a disc, each interacting with the others as r^-gamma.
    • Insider sabotage insider_sabotage: The insider sabotage model of employees whose risk of sabotage builds up over the days of a year.
    • Obesity model obesity: The obesity model of adults who eat near home and work, one step per day.
    • Shifting the burden shifting_the_burden: Meadows' shifting the burden trap, a quick fix that relieves a symptom and erodes the system's capability.
    • Success to the successful success_to_the_successful: Meadows' success to the successful trap, two competitors that share a budget by their past success.
    • The Kauai population model on region layers kauai_population: One agent per resident of the census regions of a map, moving between home, work, and favourite places.
    • Urban scaling of interactions urban_scaling_interactions: A city that grows by residents and internal links, so its meetings grow faster than its population.

    social/segregation

    • Schelling schelling: A Schelling segregation model on a grid with at most one resident per cell.
    • Stochastic Schelling stochastic_schelling: The stochastic Schelling model of agents moving between blocks, which segregates above beta = 2.

    social/spreading

    • Maki-Thompson rumours maki_thompson: The Maki-Thompson rumour model started by one spreader, which leaves about 20% of people ignorant.
    • SIS on hypergraphs with heterogeneous exposure and a nonlinear infection kernel hypergraph_exposure_sis: The SIS contagion of St-Onge et al. in the environments of a hypergraph, with a nonlinear kernel.
    • Simon-Yule growth simon_yule: The Simon model of a text that grows from one word, whose word counts follow a power law.
    • Simplicial contagion simplicial_contagion: The simplicial contagion of Iacopini et al., an SIS process on the links and triangles of a complex.
    • Watts threshold cascades watts_cascades: The Watts threshold model of global cascades started by a few random seeds.

    By tag

    B-tipping

    • Stochastic energy balance with bifurcation-, noise-, and rate-induced tipping sutera_fraedrich_tipping: The Sutera-Fraedrich stochastic energy balance set up for bifurcation-, noise-, or rate-induced tipping.

    Belousov-Zhabotinsky

    • Oregonator oregonator: The scaled Oregonator, the reduction of the FKN mechanism of the Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction.

    COMETS

    • COMETS: dynamic flux balance on a lattice with diffusion comets: An expanding colony of the E. coli core model on a lattice, which needs the extra metabolism.

    ENSO

    • ENSO delay oscillator enso: The delayed oscillator of El Niño of Suarez and Schopf, dT/dt = T - T^3 - alpha T(t - delta).

    Edgeworth box

    • Edgeworth and Red Cross barter barter: Barter of chocolate and cigarettes, in an Edgeworth box of two barterers or among many prisoners.

    El Niño

    • ENSO delay oscillator enso: The delayed oscillator of El Niño of Suarez and Schopf, dT/dt = T - T^3 - alpha T(t - delta).

    Gaia

    • Daisyworld daisyworld: Daisyworld, where white and black daisies regulate the temperature of their planet through its albedo.

    Gompertz

    • Norton-Simon Gompertzian cell kill norton_simon: The Norton-Simon model, a Gompertzian tumour killed in proportion to its size by a dose schedule.
    • Tumour and vascular volume under an angiogenesis inhibitor hahnfeldt: The Hahnfeldt model, a tumour whose carrying capacity is the vasculature it stimulates and inhibits.

    HER2

    • Paclitaxel and trastuzumab with antibody binding her2_targeted_therapy: HER2+ breast cancer cells under trastuzumab and paclitaxel, with antibody binding and drug uptake.

    Hill function

    • Goodwin oscillator goodwin_oscillator: The Goodwin oscillator, a chain of stages whose last one represses the synthesis of the first.

    IL-2

    • Effector cells, tumour, and IL-2 under adoptive therapy kirschner_panetta: The Kirschner-Panetta model of effector cells, tumour cells, and IL-2 under adoptive therapy and IL-2.
    • Optimal adoptive therapy and IL-2 dosing optimal_immunotherapy: A tumour under the adoptive therapy and IL-2 injection that minimise its burden and their cost.

    Koopman operator

    • Quadratic system with a slow manifold and a finite Koopman embedding koopman_slow_manifold: The quadratic flow x1' = mu x1, x2' = lam (x2 - x1^2), with a slow manifold and a linear embedding.

    L-system

    • Koch koch_curve: The Koch curve as the L-system F → F+F--F+F drawn by a turtle.

    Langmuir-Hinshelwood

    • Bistability on a catalyst pellet catalyst_pellet: The surface concentration of a catalyst pellet, bistable through Langmuir-Hinshelwood kinetics.

    Laplacian

    • Linear automata over rings linear_ring_automaton: The discrete Laplacian as a linear automaton on a ring, over the field of modulus elements.

    Lotka-Volterra

    • Generalized Lotka-Volterra microbial community generalized_lotka_volterra: The generalized Lotka-Volterra model of a microbial community, dx_i/dt = x_i (b_i + sum_j a_ij x_j).
    • Random Lotka-Volterra with higher-order interactions higher_order_random_lotka_volterra: A random Lotka-Volterra community with third-order interactions.

    Markov chain

    • Subshifts subshifts: A Markov chain on the golden mean shift, the configurations of a ring that never hold two adjacent ones.

    Michaelis-Menten

    • Three-node phosphorylation oscillator phosphorylation_oscillator: Three proteins whose phosphorylation cycles regulate each other in a loop that oscillates.

    Monte Carlo

    • Edwards-Anderson spin glass edwards_anderson: The Edwards-Anderson spin glass on a periodic square lattice, with quenched random bonds.
    • Ising ising: The two-dimensional Ising model on a torus, ordered below the critical temperature 2 / ln(1 + sqrt 2).
    • Ising on a graph graph_ising: The Ising model on a graph, ordered below a critical temperature set by the degrees of the nodes.
    • Mattis spin glass mattis_spin_glass: The Mattis spin glass on a periodic square lattice, with couplings J_ij = J xi_i xi_j of a pattern xi.
    • Potts potts: The q-state Potts model on a torus, ordered below the critical temperature 1 / ln(1 + sqrt q).
    • XY xy: The XY model of planar spins on a torus, with vortices that bind below the Kosterlitz-Thouless point.

    N-tipping

    • Stochastic energy balance with bifurcation-, noise-, and rate-induced tipping sutera_fraedrich_tipping: The Sutera-Fraedrich stochastic energy balance set up for bifurcation-, noise-, or rate-induced tipping.

    NK model

    • NK fitness landscapes nk_landscape: Agents that climb Kauffman's NK fitness landscape from random genomes until they reach local peaks.

    Ornstein-Uhlenbeck

    • Hasselmann stochastic climate hasselmann: Hasselmann's stochastic climate, where fast weather noise drives a slow, damped temperature anomaly.
    • Rössler with an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck control parameter ou_driven_rossler: The Rössler flow driven through its bifurcations by a slow Ornstein-Uhlenbeck control parameter.

    PD-1

    • T cells, tumour, and anti-PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor anti_pd1_checkpoint: Activated T cells, a tumour, and an anti-PD-1 drug that frees the T cells from checkpoint inhibition.

    PSA

    • Prostate cancer driven by activated androgen receptors prostate_androgen_receptor: The Jain model of prostate epithelium and cancer driven by activated androgen receptors, with PSA.

    Perron eigenvalue

    • Jain-Krishna autocatalytic networks jain_krishna: The model of Jain and Krishna, where selection of the fittest builds autocatalytic sets of molecules.

    R-tipping

    • Stochastic energy balance with bifurcation-, noise-, and rate-induced tipping sutera_fraedrich_tipping: The Sutera-Fraedrich stochastic energy balance set up for bifurcation-, noise-, or rate-induced tipping.

    Richards

    • Generalized logistic (Richards) growth generalized_logistic: A tumour that saturates at a carrying capacity, dn/dt = r n (1 - (n / K)^p), logistic for p = 1.

    Rössler

    • Rössler with an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck control parameter ou_driven_rossler: The Rössler flow driven through its bifurcations by a slow Ornstein-Uhlenbeck control parameter.

    S-system

    • Generalized mass action and S-system power-law models biochemical_systems_theory: A biochemical system of power-law rates, in the S-system or the generalized mass action form.

    SteadyCom

    • Joint, community, and SteadyCom flux balance community_fba: Two members of the E. coli core model that share a medium, which needs the extra metabolism.

    Turing

    • Brusselator fields brusselator: The Brusselator reaction-diffusion model from small noise around its steady state (a, b / a).
    • Schnakenberg schnakenberg: The Schnakenberg reaction-diffusion model, which forms Turing patterns from noise when Dv >> Du.

    Vroman effect

    • Protein corona binding on a nanoparticle nanoparticle_corona: The corona that albumin, high-density lipoprotein, and fibrinogen form on a nanoparticle in plasma.

    absorbing state

    • Contact process contact_process: The contact process on a periodic lattice, which survives above a critical infection rate near 1.65.
    • Fully connected branching and annihilation absorbing_birth_death: The fully connected branching and annihilation process, active above kappa = nu until it dies out.
    • Langevin field theory of absorbing-state transitions with a conserved energy field directed_percolation_langevin: The Langevin field theory of an absorbing-state transition, an active density fed by an energy field.

    acausal components

    • DC motor with an inertia dc_motor: A DC motor whose armature circuit of components drives an inertia on a Lagrangian coordinate.
    • Heated room with a thermostat heated_room: A room assembled from thermal and electrical components, heated under a thermostat with hysteresis.

    active gel

    • One-dimensional active viscoelastic and poroelastic gel with contractile cells active_viscoelastic_gel: A one-dimensional active viscoelastic gel, where contractile cells concentrate by dragging the gel.

    active matter

    • Active Brownian particles active_brownian_particles: Active Brownian particles in the plane, which swim at a constant speed in a diffusing direction.
    • Active Brownian particles with local alignment aligning_active_brownian_particles: Active Brownian particles in a periodic box whose headings align with the neighbours within d0.
    • Active Model B+ of motility-induced phase separation active_model_b: Active Model B+, the conserved field theory of the density of active particles.
    • Active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles active_ornstein_uhlenbeck_particles: Active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles in the plane, driven by exponentially correlated propulsion.
    • Active nematic and polar gels active_gels: An active gel, a nematic tensor or a polarisation transported in the Stokes flow of its own stresses.
    • Bird swarm with pair potentials bird_swarm: A swarm of self-propelled birds held together by a pair potential that attracts far and repels near.
    • Chiral active particles chiral_active_particles: Chiral active particles, which swim along circles of radius v / omega that drift by diffusion.
    • Depot-pumped Brownian particles depot_brownian_particles: Brownian particles with energy depots, which start at rest and take up the speed sqrt(q/gamma - c/d).
    • Dry active nematics dry_active_nematics: A dry active nematic, a conserved density coupled to a symmetric traceless alignment tensor.
    • Flocking with active and passive agents active_passive_flocking: The active and passive agents of Charbonneau (2017, section 10.4) in a periodic box.
    • Ginelli nematic particles ginelli_nematics: Polar particles with nematic alignment, which order along a common axis but move both ways along it.
    • Grégoire-Chaté cohesive flocks gregoire_chate: The Grégoire-Chaté model: aligning particles that also attract and repel, forming cohesive flocks.
    • Light-sensitive robots with sensory delay light_seeking_robots: Light-sensitive robots in a circular well, whose sensory delay decides whether they gather in the light.
    • Living crystals living_crystals: Active colloids of radius 1 with phoretic attraction, which gather into clusters that slowly coarsen.
    • Microscopic flocking with aligning binary collisions binary_collision_flocking: Self-propelled particles that flock through aligning binary collisions, the Bertin-Droz-Grégoire model.
    • Motility-induced phase separation motility_induced_phase_separation: Repulsive active Brownian disks of unit diameter, which phase separate into clusters at high speed.
    • Nonreciprocal Vicsek model nonreciprocal_vicsek: Two species of Vicsek movers in a periodic box whose alignment with each other is nonreciprocal.
    • Run-and-tumble run_and_tumble: Run-and-tumble agents in a periodic square, which diffuse with v^2 (1 + q) / (4 (1 - q)) per step.
    • Szabó cell model szabo_cells: The cells of Szabó et al. (2006) in a periodic box, which move together above a critical density.
    • Vicsek model vicsek: The Vicsek model: particles that move at a constant speed along the mean heading of their neighbours.

    active turbulence

    • Active nematic and polar gels active_gels: An active gel, a nematic tensor or a polarisation transported in the Stokes flow of its own stresses.

    activity-driven

    • Activity-driven temporal networks activity_driven_epidemics: SIS spreading on an activity-driven temporal network, whose edges last one step.

    adaptation

    • Polyhomeostatic neuron polyhomeostatic_neuron: A neuron that adapts its gain and threshold so its firing rate approaches an exponential distribution.
    • Stimulus-response, adaptive response, and anticipation with response, restore, repair, and preparedness costs adaptive_response_costs: A system that meets recurring demands by stimulus-response, adaptive response, or anticipation.

    adaptive network

    • Adaptive SIS with rewiring adaptive_sis: The SIS epidemic on a network whose susceptible nodes cut their edges to infected neighbours.
    • Coevolving voter coevolving_voter: The coevolving voter model, which fragments into consensual components when rewiring is fast.
    • Jain-Krishna autocatalytic networks jain_krishna: The model of Jain and Krishna, where selection of the fittest builds autocatalytic sets of molecules.
    • Join-a-club spins join_a_club: Join-a-club spins, agents who join a club with their acquaintances while acquaintances follow the club.
    • Sequentially linear ecosystem sequentially_linear_ecosystem: An ecosystem whose abundances follow linear dynamics between extinctions that rewrite its network.
    • Solé-Manrubia extinctions sole_manrubia: The ecosystem of Solé and Manrubia, whose species go extinct when their dependencies turn against them.

    addiction

    • Shifting the burden shifting_the_burden: Meadows' shifting the burden trap, a quick fix that relieves a symptom and erodes the system's capability.

    additive

    • Unbounded-alphabet automaton unbounded_alphabet_automaton: An additive automaton over the nonnegative integers, x'(n) = x(n - 1) + x(n), from a single 1.

    adoption

    • Fixed-line phone adoption phone_adoption: Hamill and Gilbert's adoption of fixed-line phones by British households from 1951.

    adoptive therapy

    • Effector cells, tumour, and IL-2 under adoptive therapy kirschner_panetta: The Kirschner-Panetta model of effector cells, tumour cells, and IL-2 under adoptive therapy and IL-2.
    • Optimal adoptive therapy and IL-2 dosing optimal_immunotherapy: A tumour under the adoptive therapy and IL-2 injection that minimise its burden and their cost.

    age structure

    • Fibonacci rabbits fibonacci_rabbits: Fibonacci's rabbits, N_{t+1} = N_t + N_{t-1}, where every pair older than one month breeds a new pair.

    ageing

    • Ageing random walk ageing_random_walk: Ageing random walks, whose up steps become rarer the more of them a walker has taken.

    agents

    • Active walkers and trail formation active_walkers: Active walkers who walk between the corners of a green and wear a system of trails into it.
    • Adaptive climbing in finite populations adaptive_climbing: A finite population that climbs a random fitness landscape by mutation and strong selection.
    • Ageing random walk ageing_random_walk: Ageing random walks, whose up steps become rarer the more of them a walker has taken.
    • Agent-based Lotka-Volterra agent_based_lotka_volterra: Prey and predators that walk on a grid, whose numbers cycle like the Lotka-Volterra equations.
    • Agent-based SIR with mortality, waning immunity, incubation, and lockdown agent_based_sir: People who walk on a grid and infect those in their cell, with optional extensions of the SIR model.
    • Ajani's choice and fair food fair_food: Chesney's choice between fair-trade and regular food of consumers who influence their neighbours.
    • Arthur-Polak technology evolution arthur_polak: Arthur and Polak's evolution of technology, which builds logic functions from NAND gates.
    • Axelrod culture dissemination axelrod: Axelrod's culture dissemination model on a full grid with von Neumann neighbourhoods.
    • Barabási priority queues priority_queues: The Barabási priority queue, whose waiting times follow a power law as the choice becomes greedy.
    • Belief diffusion with influentials influentials: The belief diffusion model with influentials who care passionately and weigh more with their neighbours.
    • Bernoulli process bernoulli_process: Independent Bernoulli processes, one success or failure per step, whose success counts are binomial.
    • Bilateral two-good trade on complete, isolated, and small-world networks wilhite_trade_networks: Wilhite's bilateral barter of two goods among traders on one of four trade networks.
    • Bit-string evolution on a fitness landscape bit_string_evolution: A population of bit strings that evolves on a random additive fitness landscape.
    • Boids in three dimensions boids_3d: Boids in three dimensions, birds that flock by local rules in a periodic cube.
    • Boids in two dimensions boids: Reynolds' boids in two dimensions, birds that flock by local rules without a leader.
    • Boltzmann wealth exchange boltzmann_wealth: A Boltzmann wealth exchange model where every agent starts with one unit.
    • Bonabeau hierarchies bonabeau_hierarchies: The Bonabeau model, where a hierarchy of strengths emerges above a critical density of agents.
    • Brock-Hommes heuristic switching brock_hommes: Brock and Hommes' asset market with traders switching between fundamentalists and trend chasers.
    • Brothel movement model trafficking: The brothel movement model, where victims moved between brothels leave traces in bills and train trips.
    • Car wash queue car_wash: Chesney's Clean and Wax hand car wash, a shadow account of the revenue of its workers' labour.
    • Carrying capacity of a meadow meadow_capacity: Cows that graze a summer of 25 weeks on a meadow, which shows how many cows the meadow can carry.
    • Charbonneau traffic charbonneau_traffic: Charbonneau's traffic model, where random braking of single drivers sets off traffic jams.
    • Cognitive consistency agents cognitive_consistency: Agents whose attitudes spread by conversation and settle in a belief network that seeks consistency.
    • Complex agents with internal states and standardization standardized_agents: Complex agents whose interactions make them standardized, all showing one characteristic, and ordered.
    • Cournot duopoly with beliefs cournot_duopoly: Two Cournot duopolists that adjust their output to their beliefs about each other.
    • Couzin shoal with repulsion, alignment, and informed leaders couzin_leadership: The Couzin shoal, in which a small informed minority leads a group that does not know who is informed.
    • Customers choosing between two shops of perishable goods perishable_goods_duopoly: Customers who choose between two shops of perishable goods, preferring the one that sold fresher goods.
    • DebtRank cascades debtrank: The DebtRank cascade of distress from a set of banks through their interbank loans.
    • Deffuant bounded confidence deffuant: The Deffuant bounded confidence model, whose opinions settle into about 1 / (2 * confidence) clusters.
    • Diffusion-limited aggregation diffusion_limited_aggregation: Diffusion-limited aggregation on a periodic grid, where random walkers stick to a seed at the center.
    • Double auction double_auction: Gode and Sunder's double auction of zero-intelligence traders, a step per trading period.
    • Edgeworth and Red Cross barter barter: Barter of chocolate and cigarettes, in an Edgeworth box of two barterers or among many prisoners.
    • El Farol el_farol: Arthur's El Farol bar problem, whose attendance self-organizes around the capacity.
    • Exchange with debt limit and with saving propensity kinetic_wealth_exchange: A kinetic wealth exchange model with a saving propensity or a debt limit.
    • Firm and bank credit networks credit_networks: A credit market where firms sample banks and switch to cheaper lenders, and defaults hit the lenders.
    • Fixed-line phone adoption phone_adoption: Hamill and Gilbert's adoption of fixed-line phones by British households from 1951.
    • Fractional-reserve banking fractional_reserve_banking: Customers and banks whose lending of excess reserves multiplies the base money by 1 / ratio.
    • Fragmentation fragmentation: The random fragmentation of an object of integer size, whose fragments keep breaking into smaller ones.
    • Galam majority galam_majority: The Galam majority model, where random groups adopt their majority until one opinion wins.
    • Galton-Watson branching galton_watson: A Galton-Watson branching process with Poisson offspring, one generation per step.
    • Gibrat gibrat_process: Firms that grow by Gibrat's law of proportionate effect, which makes their sizes lognormal.
    • Harvesting farmers harvesting: A socio-ecological model of farmer agents harvesting a logistically regrowing resource.
    • Hopfield network hopfield: A Hopfield network that stores patterns with Hebb's rule and recalls the first from a corrupted copy.
    • Insider sabotage insider_sabotage: The insider sabotage model of employees whose risk of sabotage builds up over the days of a year.
    • Iterated prisoner's dilemma tournament prisoners_dilemma_tournament: The evolution of strategies of the iterated prisoner's dilemma from random genomes.
    • Kesten processes kesten_process: Firms whose sizes follow Kesten's process, a random multiplicative factor plus a random positive term.
    • Kolkata Paise Restaurant kolkata_restaurant: The Kolkata Paise Restaurant problem, where diners spread over restaurants that serve one meal each.
    • Labour market labour_market: Hamill and Gilbert's labour market of firms posting wage offers and unemployed workers searching.
    • Metaphoria mortal hunter-gatherer and monetary economies metaphoria: Gooding's Metaphoria, a mortal population of hunter-gatherers or of a monetary economy.
    • Microscopic flocking with aligning binary collisions binary_collision_flocking: Self-propelled particles that flock through aligning binary collisions, the Bertin-Droz-Grégoire model.
    • Minority game and its evolutionary version minority_game: The minority game of an odd number of agents with two random strategies each.
    • Moran process moran_process: The Moran process, a population of constant size where fitter traits fix by selection and drift.
    • Multiplicative multiplicative_process: Levy and Solomon's multiplicative process, whose floor at a fraction of the mean makes a power-law tail.
    • Multiscale tumour angiogenesis tumour_angiogenesis: A tumour that outgrows its oxygen supply and recruits new blood vessels from a parent vessel.
    • NK fitness landscapes nk_landscape: Agents that climb Kauffman's NK fitness landscape from random genomes until they reach local peaks.
    • NK technology model nk_technology: McNerney's model of technological improvement, whose cost falls as a power of the cumulative production.
    • Naming game naming_game: The minimal naming game, where agents with empty inventories agree on one word.
    • Neutral Moran model with speciation neutral_biodiversity: A neutral community of constant size, where species arise by speciation and vanish by drift.
    • Obesity model obesity: The obesity model of adults who eat near home and work, one step per day.
    • Order book with imitation order_book: A stock market of fundamentalists and chartists on a grid who trade in a limit order book and imitate.
    • Pheromone foraging pheromone_foraging: Ants that find food and lay a pheromone trail home, which other ants follow: stigmergy.
    • Produce market produce_market: Hamill and Gilbert's produce market, where shoppers with lists of produce visit stalls at random.
    • Random walks network_random_walk: Random walkers on a network, which visit every node of a connected graph in proportion to its degree.
    • Random-walker epidemics on a grid and on a small world random_walker_epidemics: Random walkers among whom one sick walker starts a deadly epidemic, on a grid or on a network.
    • Ridesharing ridesharing: Riders who request trips on a city grid and cabs that a stable matching sends to them.
    • Ring-road driver agents ring_road_drivers: Drivers on a circular highway, where small random errors of speed set off traffic jams.
    • RobbyGA can collector robby_ga: Mitchell's genetic algorithm that evolves strategies for Robby, a robot that collects cans in a room.
    • Run-and-tumble run_and_tumble: Run-and-tumble agents in a periodic square, which diffuse with v^2 (1 + q) / (4 (1 - q)) per step.
    • SIR on a network as an agent model network_sir: SIR epidemics in cities at the nodes of a network, carried between cities by travellers.
    • Sample-space-reducing process sample_space_reducing: Sample-space-reducing processes, whose state visits follow Zipf's law 1 / i for lam = 1.
    • Schelling schelling: A Schelling segregation model on a grid with at most one resident per cell.
    • Shops and digital markets shops: Shops on a grid that compete for the shoppers on every cell, in person or in a digital market.
    • Simon-Yule growth simon_yule: The Simon model of a text that grows from one word, whose word counts follow a power law.
    • Social impact theory social_impact: The social impact model on a full grid, with random persuasiveness and supportiveness.
    • Stigmergic predator-prey automaton stigmergic_predator_prey: Plants, prey, and predators on a grid, whose animals share emotions through decaying marks.
    • Stochastic Schelling stochastic_schelling: The stochastic Schelling model of agents moving between blocks, which segregates above beta = 2.
    • Sugarscape sugarscape: The Sugarscape of Epstein and Axtell, foragers of random vision and metabolism on two sugar peaks.
    • Swarmtaxis swarmtaxis: The swarmtaxis algorithm, which moves a swarm of robots towards a beacon that only some of them see.
    • Sznajd sznajd: The Sznajd model, where agreeing pairs of agents convince their neighbours.
    • Tangled Nature tangled_nature: The Tangled Nature model, where organisms whose types interact through random couplings coevolve.
    • The Kauai population model on region layers kauai_population: One agent per resident of the census regions of a map, moving between home, work, and favourite places.
    • Threshold adoption threshold_adoption: The threshold adoption model in social circles, started by the 2.5% of agents with the lowest thresholds.
    • Toy and three-goods traders goods_traders: Traders who wander a grid and barter two or three goods with their neighbours.
    • Toy firm investment toy_firm_investment: Heterogeneous firms that invest out of past profits and sell at random prices, with entry and exit.
    • Tragedy of the meadow commons tragedy_of_the_commons: Herders whose cows graze a shared meadow, each adding cows while a cow pays, until the grass collapses.
    • Voter model voter_model: A voter model with one voter per node of a network.
    • Voter variants voter_variants: Voter model variants on a network, with threshold voters and a share of contrarians.
    • Watts threshold cascades watts_cascades: The Watts threshold model of global cascades started by a few random seeds.
    • Wolf and sheep wolf_sheep: The wolf and sheep predation model with one grass patch per cell.

    aggregation

    • Diffusion-limited aggregation diffusion_limited_aggregation: Diffusion-limited aggregation on a periodic grid, where random walkers stick to a seed at the center.
    • Keller-Segel chemotaxis keller_segel: The Keller-Segel model of cells that diffuse and climb the gradient of a chemical they secrete.

    aging

    • Bouchaud trap model trap_model: The Bouchaud trap model, walkers that escape from traps of exponentially distributed depths.

    agriculture

    • Cocoa cocoa: A cocoa production system, plantations that boom with their profit and bust with the insects they invite.
    • Food security models food_security: A food security system, the rice self-sufficiency of a country under subsidy, research, and extension.
    • Irrigation system irrigation: An irrigation system, a reservoir and an aquifer that keep the root zone of the crops supplied.
    • Rice milling system rice_milling: A rice milling system, a mill that buys paddy, mills it into rice and by-products, and sells them.

    alignment

    • Active Brownian particles with local alignment aligning_active_brownian_particles: Active Brownian particles in a periodic box whose headings align with the neighbours within d0.
    • Cucker-Smale flocking cucker_smale_flocking: Cucker-Smale flocking, where every agent aligns its velocity with all others, weighted by distance.
    • Vicsek model vicsek: The Vicsek model: particles that move at a constant speed along the mean heading of their neighbours.

    allometry

    • Gravity interaction model of urban scaling gravity_urban_scaling: The residents of a city at uniform positions in a disc, each interacting with the others as r^-gamma.
    • Urban scaling of interactions urban_scaling_interactions: A city that grows by residents and internal links, so its meetings grow faster than its population.
    • Von Bertalanffy growth von_bertalanffy: A tumour that grows by the balance of anabolism and catabolism, dn/dt = r n^p - d n.

    amplification

    • Adenylate cyclase kinase cascade amplifier with G-protein timer inactivation hormone_cascade_amplifier: The adenylate cyclase cascade, which amplifies a hormone pulse and ends it by the G-protein timer.

    amplitude death

    • Globally coupled Stuart-Landau oscillators with frequency spread oscillator_death: Globally coupled Stuart-Landau oscillators, whose oscillations all die for strong coupling and spread.
    • Globally coupled systems with heterogeneous time scales heterogeneous_global_coupling: Globally coupled oscillators with heterogeneous time scales, whose fixed point the coupling restabilizes.

    androgen

    • Prostate cancer under continuous androgen suppression continuous_androgen_suppression: Prostate cancer under continuous androgen suppression, which androgen-independent cells survive.

    androgen receptor

    • Prostate cancer driven by activated androgen receptors prostate_androgen_receptor: The Jain model of prostate epithelium and cancer driven by activated androgen receptors, with PSA.

    angiogenesis

    • Core and periphery vasculature under anti-angiogenic therapy vascular_core_periphery: A tumour with a live core, a live periphery, and a necrotic core, each fed by its own vasculature.
    • Gompertz growth with a vascular carrying capacity dynamic_carrying_capacity: Gompertz growth under a carrying capacity that the vessels on the tumour surface keep raising.
    • Multiscale tumour angiogenesis tumour_angiogenesis: A tumour that outgrows its oxygen supply and recruits new blood vessels from a parent vessel.
    • Tumour and vascular volume under an angiogenesis inhibitor hahnfeldt: The Hahnfeldt model, a tumour whose carrying capacity is the vasculature it stimulates and inhibits.

    angular momentum

    • Rotating balls on rods rotating_balls_on_rods: Two balls on rods that turn about a vertical axis and conserve their angular momentum.

    annealing

    • Simulated annealing, genetic algorithms, and differential evolution evolutionary_optimisers: A population of candidates that searches a two-dimensional landscape, one generation per step.

    anomalous diffusion

    • Annealed transient time motion annealed_transient_time_motion: Annealed transient time motion, Brownian walkers whose diffusion coefficient changes at random times.
    • Continuous-time random walk continuous_time_random_walk: The continuous-time random walk, Gaussian jumps after waiting times with the tail tau^(-1 - alpha).
    • Diffusion in a speckle field diffusion_in_a_speckle_field: Brownian particles in a random speckle field, trapped at hotspots for longer as the field grows stronger.
    • Fractional Brownian motion fractional_brownian_motion: Fractional Brownian motion, dx = sqrt(2 D) dB_H, with <x^2> = 2 D t^(2 H) along every axis.
    • Fully biased walk among quenched broad traps biased_trap_walk: Walkers that hop always to the right through quenched traps with broadly distributed trapping times.
    • Lévy walk levy_walk: The Lévy walk, flights at constant speed in random directions for times with the tail tau^(-1 - sigma).
    • Scaled Brownian motion scaled_brownian_motion: Scaled Brownian motion, dx = sqrt(2 K alpha (t + t0)^(alpha - 1)) dW, with <x^2> ~ 2 K t^alpha.
    • Superdiffusive Levy flight levy_flight: The Lévy flight, a walk whose jumps have lengths with the tail l^(-1 - mu) in random directions.

    anomalous relaxation

    • Fractional relaxation fractional_relaxation: Fractional relaxation D^alpha x = -lambda x, which decays as the Mittag-Leffler function E_alpha.

    ant

    • Langton's ant langtons_ant: Langton's ant, which wanders chaotically for about 10,000 steps before it builds a periodic highway.

    anti-angiogenic therapy

    • Core and periphery vasculature under anti-angiogenic therapy vascular_core_periphery: A tumour with a live core, a live periphery, and a necrotic core, each fed by its own vasculature.
    • Tumour and vascular volume under an angiogenesis inhibitor hahnfeldt: The Hahnfeldt model, a tumour whose carrying capacity is the vasculature it stimulates and inhibits.

    antiangiogenic therapy

    • Hahnfeldt model with effector cells, pharmacokinetics, resistance, and toxicity angiogenesis_immunotherapy: The Hahnfeldt tumour with effector cells under bevacizumab and atezolizumab every three weeks.

    antibody

    • Paclitaxel and trastuzumab with antibody binding her2_targeted_therapy: HER2+ breast cancer cells under trastuzumab and paclitaxel, with antibody binding and drug uptake.

    anticipation

    • Stimulus-response, adaptive response, and anticipation with response, restore, repair, and preparedness costs adaptive_response_costs: A system that meets recurring demands by stimulus-response, adaptive response, or anticipation.

    antigenicity

    • Tumour-immune model with dendritic licensing, IL-2, IL-10, and TGF-beta tumour_immune_suppression: A tumour against dendritic, cytotoxic, helper, and regulatory T cells with IL-2, IL-10, and TGF-beta.

    arbitrage

    • Random-walk traders with arbitrage arbitrage_traders: Schwichtenberg's diffusion of a good by random-walk traders, minimally coupled to exchange rates.
    • Traders and exchange rates coupled through arbitrage as lattice electrodynamics gauge_arbitrage_market: Exchange-rate potentials on links as lattice Maxwell fields, sourced by traders who move a good on sites.

    arms race

    • Escalation escalation: Meadows' escalation trap, two parties that each want to exceed the other's stock by a margin.

    arnold tongues

    • Circle circle_map: The sine circle map θ' = θ + Ω - K / (2π) sin 2πθ (mod 1), which locks into Arnold tongues.

    asset

    • Correlated geometric Brownian motions correlated_geometric_brownian_motion: Two assets whose prices follow geometric Brownian motions driven by correlated Wiener processes.
    • Geometric Brownian motion geometric_brownian_motion: An asset whose price follows geometric Brownian motion.

    asset pricing

    • Brock-Hommes heuristic switching brock_hommes: Brock and Hommes' asset market with traders switching between fundamentalists and trend chasers.

    associative memory

    • Asymmetric diluted Hopfield network diluted_hopfield: The asymmetric diluted Hopfield network, which recalls a stored pattern below its memory capacity.
    • Hopfield network hopfield: A Hopfield network that stores patterns with Hebb's rule and recalls the first from a corrupted copy.

    assortativity

    • Centralities, assortativity, communities, and motifs network_structure_analysis: A network recorded with its centralities, degree mixing, communities, and triangle z-score.

    atmosphere

    • Lorenz-84 lorenz_84: Lorenz-84, the general circulation reduced to a westerly jet and a travelling wave, chaotic for F = 8.
    • Lorenz-96 lorenz_96: Lorenz-96, dx_i/dt = (x_{i+1} - x_{i-2}) x_{i-1} - x_i + F on a ring of sites around a latitude circle.

    attack

    • Random failures and targeted attacks on networks network_attack: Failures or attacks on a scale-free network, robust to random failures but fragile to attacks on hubs.

    attractor

    • Chua double and multiple scrolls chua: Chua's circuit, whose double-scroll or multiscroll attractor is chaotic.
    • Hopfield network hopfield: A Hopfield network that stores patterns with Hebb's rule and recalls the first from a corrupted copy.

    attractors

    • Boolean model of the mammalian cell cycle mammalian_cell_cycle: The Boolean model of the mammalian cell cycle of Faure et al., ten proteins updated synchronously.
    • Three-gene Boolean network three_gene_boolean_network: The three-gene Boolean network of Raman, updated synchronously.

    autocatalysis

    • Brusselator ODE brusselator_ode: The well-mixed Brusselator, which oscillates on a limit cycle when b > 1 + a**2.
    • Cubic autocatalysis cubic_autocatalysis: Cubic autocatalysis A + 2B -> 3B with the decay B -> C in a continuously fed reactor.
    • Hypercycles hypercycles: A network of self-replicating molecules whose catalysis keeps a set of them alive, a hypercycle.

    autocatalytic set

    • Jain-Krishna autocatalytic networks jain_krishna: The model of Jain and Krishna, where selection of the fittest builds autocatalytic sets of molecules.

    autoregressive

    • Random walk with autoregressive velocity random_walk_with_memory: Random walks whose velocity is an autoregressive process, x ← x + v and v ← alpha v + xi.

    avalanches

    • Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld sandpile sandpile: The Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld sandpile on a lattice with open edges, started from random stable heights.
    • Charbonneau traffic charbonneau_traffic: Charbonneau's traffic model, where random braking of single drivers sets off traffic jams.
    • Manna sandpile manna_sandpile: The Manna sandpile, a stochastic sandpile of another universality class than Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld.
    • Solé-Manrubia extinctions sole_manrubia: The ecosystem of Solé and Manrubia, whose species go extinct when their dependencies turn against them.

    backpropagation through time

    • Elman recurrent network trained by backpropagation elman_network: Elman's simple recurrent network, which learns to predict the next bit of a temporal XOR stream.

    bacteria

    • Run-and-tumble run_and_tumble: Run-and-tumble agents in a periodic square, which diffuse with v^2 (1 + q) / (4 (1 - q)) per step.

    balancing feedback

    • Cooling coffee cooling_coffee: A cup of coffee whose temperature relaxes to that of the room, T' = -k (T - T_room).

    bang-bang

    • Optimal harvesting optimal_harvesting: A logistic resource harvested with the effort that maximises its discounted profit.
    • Pendulum swing-up pendulum_swing_up: A pendulum swung up to its inverted position by a bang-bang acceleration of its pivot.

    banks

    • Firm and bank credit networks credit_networks: A credit market where firms sample banks and switch to cheaper lenders, and defaults hit the lenders.
    • Fractional-reserve banking fractional_reserve_banking: Customers and banks whose lending of excess reserves multiplies the base money by 1 / ratio.

    barter

    • Bilateral two-good trade on complete, isolated, and small-world networks wilhite_trade_networks: Wilhite's bilateral barter of two goods among traders on one of four trade networks.
    • Edgeworth and Red Cross barter barter: Barter of chocolate and cigarettes, in an Edgeworth box of two barterers or among many prisoners.
    • Toy and three-goods traders goods_traders: Traders who wander a grid and barter two or three goods with their neighbours.

    basins

    • Newton-Raphson map newton_raphson_map: Newton's method for z³ = 1 in the complex plane, z' = (2z³ + 1) / (3z²), in real coordinates.

    batch culture

    • Dynamic flux balance analysis of a batch culture dynamic_fba: A batch culture of the E. coli core model, which needs the extra metabolism.

    batteries

    • Faraday-disk charger faraday_disk: A battery charger driven by a Faraday disk generator whose own current strengthens its field.

    bernoulli shift

    • Bernoulli doubling map doubling_map: An ensemble of the doubling map x' = 2x (mod 1), iterated exactly on fractions with an odd denominator.

    bid rent

    • Von Thünen land use von_thunen: A square plain around one market at its centre, whose every cell grows the crop of highest bid rent.

    bifurcation

    • Cusp normal forms cusp_form: The cusp normal form x' = β1 + β2 x - x³, bistable inside the cusp 27 β1² < 4 β2³.
    • Hopf hopf_form: The Hopf normal form, whose focus gives birth to a limit cycle of radius √(-μ / a) as μ crosses 0.
    • Saddle-node saddle_node_form: The saddle-node normal form x' = μ - x², whose two equilibria ±√μ meet and vanish at μ = 0.
    • Stochastic on-off intermittency on_off_intermittency: Stochastic on-off intermittency, dx/dt = (epsilon + xi) x - x^3 with Stratonovich white noise xi.
    • Subcritical Hopf normal form subcritical_hopf_form: The subcritical Hopf normal form, where a stable focus coexists with a stable limit cycle.
    • Takens-Bogdanov takens_bogdanov_form: The Takens-Bogdanov normal form x' = y, y' = β1 + β2 x + x² + s x y, where a saddle-node meets a Hopf.

    bifurcation diagram

    • Rössler with an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck control parameter ou_driven_rossler: The Rössler flow driven through its bifurcations by a slow Ornstein-Uhlenbeck control parameter.

    billiard

    • Circular billiard circular_billiard: A particle moving freely inside a circle and reflecting specularly off its wall.
    • Dynamical billiards of Sinai and mushroom shapes billiards: A particle moving freely on a billiard table and reflecting specularly off its walls.

    binomial

    • Two-phase zone exchange two_phase_zone_exchange: Independent zones of a two-phase apparatus, each exchanging particles with the rest of the apparatus.

    biochemical systems theory

    • Generalized mass action and S-system power-law models biochemical_systems_theory: A biochemical system of power-law rates, in the S-system or the generalized mass action form.

    biodiversity

    • Neutral Moran model with speciation neutral_biodiversity: A neutral community of constant size, where species arise by speciation and vanish by drift.

    birth-death

    • Neutral birth-death with hopping between boxes neutral_clustering: Organisms that divide, die, and hop between patches on a periodic lattice, and gather in clusters.

    birth-death process

    • Birth-death process and M/M/1 queue birth_death_queue: Independent M/M/1 queues, birth-death processes with constant arrival and service rates.
    • Fully connected branching and annihilation absorbing_birth_death: The fully connected branching and annihilation process, active above kappa = nu until it dies out.

    bistability

    • Bistability on a catalyst pellet catalyst_pellet: The surface concentration of a catalyst pellet, bistable through Langmuir-Hinshelwood kinetics.
    • Chemical Langevin equation of the Schlögl reaction chemical_langevin_equation: The chemical Langevin equation of Schlögl's bistable reaction, whose noise switches between two states.
    • Cubic autocatalysis cubic_autocatalysis: Cubic autocatalysis A + 2B -> 3B with the decay B -> C in a continuously fed reactor.
    • Cusp normal forms cusp_form: The cusp normal form x' = β1 + β2 x - x³, bistable inside the cusp 27 β1² < 4 β2³.
    • Genetic toggle switch toggle_switch: The genetic toggle switch of Gardner, Cantor, and Collins, two genes that repress each other.
    • Network of interacting tipping elements tipping_cascade_network: A network of tipping elements, where one element pushed past its tipping point can tip its neighbours.
    • SIS on hypergraphs with heterogeneous exposure and a nonlinear infection kernel hypergraph_exposure_sis: The SIS contagion of St-Onge et al. in the environments of a hypergraph, with a nonlinear kernel.
    • Simplicial contagion simplicial_contagion: The simplicial contagion of Iacopini et al., an SIS process on the links and triangles of a complex.
    • Stommel thermohaline boxes stommel: Stommel's two-box thermohaline circulation, bistable between a thermal and a haline mode.
    • Subcritical Hopf normal form subcritical_hopf_form: The subcritical Hopf normal form, where a stable focus coexists with a stable limit cycle.
    • Zero-dimensional energy balance with ice albedo energy_balance: The zero-dimensional energy balance of the Earth, bistable through the ice-albedo feedback.

    blocked states

    • Shaken frictional spring-block chain shaken_spring_block: A chain of blocks joined by springs on a frictional substrate, shaken and relaxed in turn.

    boltzmann equation

    • Microscopic flocking with aligning binary collisions binary_collision_flocking: Self-propelled particles that flock through aligning binary collisions, the Bertin-Droz-Grégoire model.

    bone marrow

    • Bone-marrow and blood cells with blasts and cancer stem cells bone_marrow_blood_leukaemia: The bone marrow and blood model of leukaemia, in which blasts crowd out the normal cells.

    boolean network

    • Boolean model of the mammalian cell cycle mammalian_cell_cycle: The Boolean model of the mammalian cell cycle of Faure et al., ten proteins updated synchronously.
    • Boolean repressilator boolean_repressilator: The Boolean repressilator, where LacI represses TetR, TetR represses cI, and cI represses LacI.
    • Kauffman random Boolean networks random_boolean_network: A Kauffman random Boolean network, nodes updated together by random functions of k random inputs.
    • Probabilistic Boolean network probabilistic_boolean_network: A probabilistic Boolean network, whose nodes draw one of their candidate functions at every step.
    • Regulatory flux balance analysis regulatory_fba: A batch culture on glucose and acetate with Boolean catabolite repression, which needs the extra.
    • Three-gene Boolean network three_gene_boolean_network: The three-gene Boolean network of Raman, updated synchronously.
    • Yeast cell-cycle network yeast_cell_cycle: The Boolean network of the budding yeast cell cycle of Li et al., eleven proteins and their regulation.

    boom and bust

    • Cocoa cocoa: A cocoa production system, plantations that boom with their profit and bust with the insects they invite.

    boundary

    • Ideal gas ideal_gas: An ideal gas of non-interacting molecules in a reflecting box.

    bounded confidence

    • Deffuant bounded confidence deffuant: The Deffuant bounded confidence model, whose opinions settle into about 1 / (2 * confidence) clusters.
    • Hegselmann-Krause hegselmann_krause: The Hegselmann-Krause model, whose opinions freeze within a few steps into clusters about 2 ε apart.

    bounded rationality

    • Brock-Hommes heuristic switching brock_hommes: Brock and Hommes' asset market with traders switching between fundamentalists and trend chasers.
    • El Farol el_farol: Arthur's El Farol bar problem, whose attendance self-organizes around the capacity.

    braess paradox

    • Swing-equation power grid with Braess paradox power_grid: A ring power grid in the swing-equation model, where more transmission capacity can break synchrony.

    branching process

    • Galton-Watson branching galton_watson: A Galton-Watson branching process with Poisson offspring, one generation per step.

    breaking

    • Wave-number conservation and wave breaking wave_breaking: The kinematic wave equation of deep-water wave trains on a periodic interval of length 2 pi.

    breast cancer

    • Gompertzian cell-cycle phases under tamoxifen tamoxifen_cell_cycle: A breast tumour in Gompertzian cell-cycle phases under daily tamoxifen and its active metabolite.

    brownian motion

    • Brownian particle near a wall brownian_near_wall: A Brownian particle whose diffusion slows near a wall, D(z) = D0 z² / (z² + a²), as it settles on it.
    • Inertial and overdamped Brownian motion brownian_motion: Free Brownian particles with inertia, m x'' = -gamma x' + sqrt(2 kT gamma) W, or without it.
    • On-off flashing ratchet flashing_ratchet: The on-off flashing ratchet, Brownian particles in a sawtooth potential switched on and off at random.
    • Optical trap including oscillating and blinking traps optical_trap: Overdamped particles in a harmonic optical trap, still, oscillating, or blinking.
    • Overdamped particle in a tilted periodic potential tilted_periodic_potential: Overdamped particles in the tilted periodic potential V(x) = U0 cos(2 pi x / L) - f x.

    bullwhip effect

    • Beer distribution game beer_game: Sterman's beer distribution game, a supply chain whose orders swing wider at every echelon upstream.

    bump

    • Amari neural field amari_neural_field: The Amari neural field, whose lateral inhibition holds a stationary bump of activity.

    bursting

    • Izhikevich izhikevich: The Izhikevich neuron, whose four parameters give regular spiking, bursting, chattering, and more.

    bursts

    • Barabási priority queues priority_queues: The Barabási priority queue, whose waiting times follow a power law as the choice becomes greedy.
    • Negative autoregulation and bursty gene expression negative_autoregulation: A gene that represses its own transcription and makes its protein in bursts.

    business cycle

    • Multiplier-accelerator multiplier_accelerator: Samuelson's multiplier-accelerator, Y_{t+1} = c (1 + v) Y_t - c v Y_{t-1} + G.
    • Toy firm investment toy_firm_investment: Heterogeneous firms that invest out of past profits and sell at random prices, with entry and exit.

    canards

    • Modified Chua with mixed-mode oscillations mixed_mode_chua: A modified Chua circuit on three time scales, whose oscillations mix small and large amplitudes.

    cancer stem cells

    • Normal and malignant stem-cell compartments with feedback and therapy stem_cell_differentiation: The eight-compartment model of normal and malignant stem-cell lineages with feedback and therapy.

    capital

    • Pontryagin capital and consumption optimal_consumption: The Ramsey economy that chooses the consumption path maximising its discounted utility.

    car following

    • Car following with delay delayed_car_following: A chain of cars that react to the speed difference to the car ahead after a reaction time.
    • Intelligent driver model intelligent_driver_model: The intelligent driver model of cars on a ring road.
    • Langevin car-following toward a density-dependent speed langevin_traffic: Cars on a ring road whose speeds relax with noise towards a desired speed set by the local density.
    • Optimal velocity optimal_velocity: The optimal velocity model of cars on a ring road, where uniform flow breaks into stop-and-go waves.

    carbon cycle

    • Rothman excitable carbon cycle carbon_cycle: Rothman's excitable carbon cycle, where a large enough perturbation of the ocean sets off an excursion.

    carbon-13 flux analysis

    • Carbon-13 metabolic flux analysis carbon_13_mfa: A metabolic network that LabellingAnalysis fits to labelling data, the TCA example by default.

    cardiac

    • Aliev-Panfilov cardiac tissue aliev_panfilov: The Aliev-Panfilov model of cardiac tissue, started from a broken wave that curls into a spiral.

    cardiovascular

    • Lumped cardiovascular model cardiovascular: A closed lumped model of the systemic circulation driven by a left ventricle of varying elastance.

    carrying capacity

    • Carrying capacity of a meadow meadow_capacity: Cows that graze a summer of 25 weeks on a meadow, which shows how many cows the meadow can carry.

    cascade

    • Adenylate cyclase kinase cascade amplifier with G-protein timer inactivation hormone_cascade_amplifier: The adenylate cyclase cascade, which amplifies a hormone pulse and ends it by the G-protein timer.
    • Cascade classifier cascade_classifier: A cascade classifier, a column of stages that separates a narrow size class of particles by an air flow.

    cascades

    • Network of interacting tipping elements tipping_cascade_network: A network of tipping elements, where one element pushed past its tipping point can tip its neighbours.
    • Watts threshold cascades watts_cascades: The Watts threshold model of global cascades started by a few random seeds.

    catalysis

    • Bistability on a catalyst pellet catalyst_pellet: The surface concentration of a catalyst pellet, bistable through Langmuir-Hinshelwood kinetics.

    celestial mechanics

    • Satellite transfer satellite_transfer: A satellite moved between Kepler orbits of equal angular momentum by radial thrust.

    cell communication

    • Intercellular exchange through gap junctions and tunnelling nanotubes on a cell network nanotube_gap_junction_exchange: The intercellular exchange of a substance through gap junctions and tunnelling nanotubes on a network.
    • Substance exchange between logistic cells in a closed contour closed_contour_cell_exchange: The exchange of signalling molecules between logistic cells arranged in a closed contour.

    cell complex

    • Explosive topological Kuramoto of node and link phases on a simplicial complex topological_kuramoto: Phases on the nodes and links of a clique complex, coupled through its incidence by order parameters.
    • Gauge theory of agents on a network gauge_network_agents: Agent phases on the nodes of a network that relax towards the transported phases of their neighbours.
    • Lattice Maxwell and gauge link fields lattice_gauge_fields: Link variables on the cell complex of a periodic lattice, sampled or evolved in real time.
    • Traders and exchange rates coupled through arbitrage as lattice electrodynamics gauge_arbitrage_market: Exchange-rate potentials on links as lattice Maxwell fields, sourced by traders who move a good on sites.

    cell cycle

    • Boolean model of the mammalian cell cycle mammalian_cell_cycle: The Boolean model of the mammalian cell cycle of Faure et al., ten proteins updated synchronously.
    • Cell-cycle compartments with killing, blocking, and recruiting agents cell_cycle_chemotherapy: Tumour cells in cell-cycle compartments under killing, blocking, and recruiting agents.
    • Gompertzian cell-cycle phases under tamoxifen tamoxifen_cell_cycle: A breast tumour in Gompertzian cell-cycle phases under daily tamoxifen and its active metabolite.
    • Yeast cell-cycle network yeast_cell_cycle: The Boolean network of the budding yeast cell cycle of Li et al., eleven proteins and their regulation.

    cell quota

    • Droop cell-quota growth droop_cell_quota: The Droop model, a phytoplankton whose growth rate follows the nutrient stored in its cells.
    • Prostate cancer with an androgen cell quota and PSA prostate_cell_quota: The Portz cell-quota model of prostate cancer, whose cells grow on their internal androgen.

    cellular automaton

    • Automata on the Grigorchuk group grigorchuk_automaton: The majority automaton on a ball of the Grigorchuk group, a group of intermediate growth.
    • Automata on the free group free_group_automaton: The majority automaton on a ball of the free group, a tree in which every cell follows its neighbours.
    • Baumslag-Solitar groups baumslag_solitar_automaton: The majority automaton on a ball of the Baumslag-Solitar group BS(m, n), of exponential growth.
    • Cyclic cellular automaton cyclic_cellular_automaton: Griffeath's cyclic cellular automaton, whose random levels organize into spiral waves.
    • Heisenberg heisenberg_automaton: The majority automaton on a ball of the discrete Heisenberg group, of polynomial growth of degree 4.
    • Lamplighter lamplighter_automaton: The parity automaton on a ball of the lamplighter group, a linear rule over the field of two elements.
    • Linear automata over rings linear_ring_automaton: The discrete Laplacian as a linear automaton on a ring, over the field of modulus elements.
    • Q2R reversible Ising automaton q2r: The Q2R automaton, a reversible, energy-conserving Ising dynamics on a periodic lattice of even sides.

    census

    • The Kauai population model on region layers kauai_population: One agent per resident of the census regions of a map, moving between home, work, and favourite places.

    centrality

    • Centralities, assortativity, communities, and motifs network_structure_analysis: A network recorded with its centralities, degree mixing, communities, and triangle z-score.
    • PageRank iterations on networks pagerank: The PageRank iteration r_i' = (1 - d) / n + d Σ_j A_ij r_j / k_j on an undirected network.

    chaos

    • Aggregate-averaging synchronization aggregate_averaging_synchronization: Two logistic maps coupled by aggregate averaging, which synchronize their chaos for strong coupling.
    • Baker baker_map: The generalized baker map, which stretches the unit square along x and stacks the two pieces in y.
    • Bernoulli doubling map doubling_map: An ensemble of the doubling map x' = 2x (mod 1), iterated exactly on fractions with an odd denominator.
    • Cat map cat_map: Arnold's cat map (x, y) → (2x + y, x + y) (mod 1), an area-preserving hyperbolic map of the torus.
    • Chua double and multiple scrolls chua: Chua's circuit, whose double-scroll or multiscroll attractor is chaotic.
    • Complex Ginzburg-Landau complex_ginzburg_landau: The complex Ginzburg-Landau equation A_t = A + (1 + i b) laplacian(A) - (1 + i c) |A|^2 A.
    • Coupled Rössler and the master stability function coupled_rossler: Chaotic Rössler oscillators on a ring, diffusively coupled through their second variable.
    • Coupled map lattices on networks coupled_map_lattices_on_networks: Chaotic logistic maps on the nodes of a network, each pulled towards the mean of its neighbours.
    • Coupled soil and deep temperature maps soil_temperature: The coupled maps of the soil surface temperature and the deeper soil temperature.
    • Cubic chaotic map and its chaotic walk cubic_chaotic_map: Bertin's cubic chaotic map and the chaotic walk it drives, which spreads like a random walk.
    • Double pendulum double_pendulum: A double pendulum, a pendulum hanging from the bob of another, written as its two Lagrange equations.
    • Duffing duffing: The forced Duffing oscillator x'' = -delta x' - alpha x - beta x^3 + gamma cos(omega t), chaotic here.
    • Dynamical billiards of Sinai and mushroom shapes billiards: A particle moving freely on a billiard table and reflecting specularly off its walls.
    • Elementary automata elementary_automaton: An elementary cellular automaton by its Wolfram number, started from a single live cell by default.
    • Fractional Lorenz fractional_lorenz: The fractional Lorenz flow of Grigorenko and Grigorenko, chaotic for orders close enough to 1.
    • Generalized tent map skew_tent_map: An ensemble of the skew tent map, whose density relaxes to the uniform invariant density for any a.
    • Gissinger geodynamo geodynamo: Gissinger's geodynamo, whose dipole field reverses at irregular times.
    • Hénon map henon_map: The Hénon map x' = 1 - a x² + y, y' = b x, with a fractal strange attractor for its defaults.
    • Hénon-Heiles henon_heiles: The Hénon-Heiles model of a star in a galactic potential, whose motion is chaotic at higher energies.
    • Intermittency maps intermittency_map: The Pomeau-Manneville map x' = x + x^z (mod 1), whose long laminar phases near 0 end in chaotic bursts.
    • Kuramoto-Sivashinsky kuramoto_sivashinsky: The Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation u_t = -u u_x - u_xx - u_xxxx, spatiotemporally chaotic.
    • Logistic map logistic_map: The logistic map x_{t+1} = r x_t (1 - x_t), which reaches chaos through period doubling as r grows.
    • Lorenz lorenz: The Lorenz-63 model of convection, chaotic on a butterfly-shaped attractor for its standard parameters.
    • Lorenz-84 lorenz_84: Lorenz-84, the general circulation reduced to a westerly jet and a travelling wave, chaotic for F = 8.
    • Lorenz-96 lorenz_96: Lorenz-96, dx_i/dt = (x_{i+1} - x_{i-2}) x_{i-1} - x_i + F on a ring of sites around a latitude circle.
    • Mackey-Glass mackey_glass: The Mackey-Glass equation x' = beta x(t - tau) / (1 + x(t - tau)^n) - gamma x of blood cell production.
    • Memristor oscillator memristor_oscillator: The simplest memristor oscillator: a capacitor, an inductor, and a memristor in series.
    • N-body and solar system n_body: Bodies in the plane that attract each other pairwise by Newtonian gravity.
    • Restricted three-body problem restricted_three_body: A light body moving in the plane of two primaries on circular orbits, in the frame that rotates with them.
    • Rössler rossler: The Rössler model, a chaotic flow with one folded band for its standard parameters.
    • Rössler with an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck control parameter ou_driven_rossler: The Rössler flow driven through its bifurcations by a slow Ornstein-Uhlenbeck control parameter.
    • Sitnikov problem sitnikov: A light body moving on the axis through the centre of mass of two equal primaries, normal to their orbit.
    • Sprott jerk sprott_jerk: Sprott's jerk equation x''' = -A x'' - x' + |x| - 1, chaotic near A = 0.6.
    • Standard standard_map: The Chirikov standard map p' = p + K sin θ, θ' = θ + p', with global chaos above K ≈ 0.9716.
    • Störmer charge in a dipole field stormer_problem: A charged particle moving in the magnetic dipole field of a planet, the Störmer problem.
    • Tent tent_map: The tent map x' = μ min(x, 1 - x), chaotic with Lyapunov exponent ln μ for μ above 1.
    • Towel maps towel_map: Rössler's towel map, a three-dimensional map with two positive Lyapunov exponents.

    chaos game

    • Iterated function systems by the chaos game chaos_game: Points that draw the attractor of an iterated function system by the chaos game.

    chartists

    • Order book with imitation order_book: A stock market of fundamentalists and chartists on a grid who trade in a limit order book and imitate.

    checkpoint inhibitor

    • T cells, tumour, and anti-PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor anti_pd1_checkpoint: Activated T cells, a tumour, and an anti-PD-1 drug that frees the T cells from checkpoint inhibition.

    chemical Langevin equation

    • Chemical Langevin equation of the Schlögl reaction chemical_langevin_equation: The chemical Langevin equation of Schlögl's bistable reaction, whose noise switches between two states.
    • Chemical Langevin equation of the enzyme network chemical_langevin_network: The chemical Langevin equation of the enzyme reaction E + S <-> C -> E + P.

    chemotaxis

    • Keller-Segel chemotaxis keller_segel: The Keller-Segel model of cells that diffuse and climb the gradient of a chemical they secrete.

    chemotherapy

    • Acquired and induced resistance with phenotype switching drug_resistance_switching: Sensitive cells and cells resistant by mutation or by a reversible phenotype switch under a dose.
    • Cell-cycle compartments with killing, blocking, and recruiting agents cell_cycle_chemotherapy: Tumour cells in cell-cycle compartments under killing, blocking, and recruiting agents.
    • Glioma, glia, and neurons under temozolomide and virus glioma_chemovirotherapy: Glia, neurons, and a glioma under a constant temozolomide infusion and an oncolytic virus.
    • Normal, tumour, and immune cells under chemotherapy de_pillis_radunskaya: The de Pillis-Radunskaya model of immune, tumour, and normal cells under a constant drug infusion.
    • Norton-Simon Gompertzian cell kill norton_simon: The Norton-Simon model, a Gompertzian tumour killed in proportion to its size by a dose schedule.
    • Optimal chemotherapy dosing optimal_chemotherapy: A patient under the chemotherapy that minimises the tumour burden and the toxicity of the drug.
    • Paclitaxel and trastuzumab with antibody binding her2_targeted_therapy: HER2+ breast cancer cells under trastuzumab and paclitaxel, with antibody binding and drug uptake.
    • Primary and secondary sites with a migration delay under chemotherapy delayed_metastasis: Normal and tumour cells at a primary and a secondary site, with a delayed migration of tumour cells.
    • Red-cell production under 6-mercaptopurine erythropoiesis_mercaptopurine: The production of red cells under a constant level of 6-mercaptopurine, starting from health.
    • Resistance subpopulations under three drugs multidrug_resistance: A tumour of eight populations resistant to subsets of three drugs, given by constant infusions.
    • Resting and hunting immune cells with a conversion delay under chemotherapy delayed_resting_hunting_chemotherapy: The tumour-immune model of resting and hunting cells with a conversion delay, under a drug infusion.
    • Skipper-Schabel-Wilcox log-kill skipper_log_kill: The log-kill model, an exponentially growing tumour of which every dose kills a fixed fraction.
    • Tumour, NK cells, CD8 T cells, and lymphocytes under chemoimmunotherapy chemoimmunotherapy: A tumour with NK cells, CD8 T cells, and lymphocytes under chemotherapy, IL-2, and TIL injection.
    • Two tumour clones under chemotherapy and dendritic-cell vaccine clonal_chemoimmunotherapy: Two competing tumour clones, sensitive and resistant to chemotherapy, under a drug and a vaccine.
    • Uninfected and infected cells, virus, and chemotherapy chemovirotherapy: Uninfected and infected tumour cells, an oncolytic virus, and a chemotherapeutic drug.

    chimera

    • Kuramoto-Sakaguchi chimera kuramoto_sakaguchi_chimera: Two populations of identical phase oscillators with phase lag, where one synchronizes and one drifts.
    • Nonlocal ring chimera nonlocal_ring_chimera: Identical phase oscillators on a ring, each coupled to its R nearest neighbours on both sides.

    chiral phase

    • Nonreciprocal Vicsek model nonreciprocal_vicsek: Two species of Vicsek movers in a periodic box whose alignment with each other is nonreciprocal.

    chirality

    • Chiral active particles chiral_active_particles: Chiral active particles, which swim along circles of radius v / omega that drift by diffusion.

    circadian rhythm

    • Drosophila circadian clock circadian_clock: Goldbeter's model of the Drosophila circadian clock, PER that represses its own transcription.

    circuit

    • Chua double and multiple scrolls chua: Chua's circuit, whose double-scroll or multiscroll attractor is chaotic.
    • Circuits under periodic impulses impulsive_circuits: An RLC circuit driven by a periodic train of current impulses, L C x'' + R C x' + x = A Σ δ(t - k T).
    • DC motor with an inertia dc_motor: A DC motor whose armature circuit of components drives an inertia on a Lagrangian coordinate.
    • Memristor oscillator memristor_oscillator: The simplest memristor oscillator: a capacitor, an inductor, and a memristor in series.
    • Modified Chua with mixed-mode oscillations mixed_mode_chua: A modified Chua circuit on three time scales, whose oscillations mix small and large amplitudes.
    • RLC circuit rlc_circuit: A series RLC circuit written as Kirchhoff's voltage law, L q'' + R q' + q / C = V cos(ω t).
    • Tunnel-diode oscillator tunnel_diode_oscillator: A tunnel-diode oscillator: an inductor and a capacitor in parallel with a negative-resistance diode.

    circulation

    • Lumped cardiovascular model cardiovascular: A closed lumped model of the systemic circulation driven by a left ventricle of varying elastance.

    clubs

    • Join-a-club spins join_a_club: Join-a-club spins, agents who join a club with their acquaintances while acquaintances follow the club.

    clustering

    • Holme-Kim growth holme_kim: Holme-Kim growth, scale-free like Barabási-Albert growth but with clustering that stays high.
    • Neutral birth-death with hopping between boxes neutral_clustering: Organisms that divide, die, and hop between patches on a periodic lattice, and gather in clusters.
    • Popularity-similarity network popularity_similarity_network: Popularity-similarity growth, scale-free and clustered, whose nodes attach by hyperbolic distance.

    clusters

    • Continuum percolation continuum_percolation: Overlapping disks at uniform positions in a square, whose clusters percolate near a filling of 1.13.
    • Deffuant bounded confidence deffuant: The Deffuant bounded confidence model, whose opinions settle into about 1 / (2 * confidence) clusters.
    • Hegselmann-Krause hegselmann_krause: The Hegselmann-Krause model, whose opinions freeze within a few steps into clusters about 2 ε apart.
    • Living crystals living_crystals: Active colloids of radius 1 with phoretic attraction, which gather into clusters that slowly coarsen.
    • Social impact theory social_impact: The social impact model on a full grid, with random persuasiveness and supportiveness.

    co-simulation

    • Active walkers and trail formation active_walkers: Active walkers who walk between the corners of a green and wear a system of trails into it.
    • Dynamic flux balance analysis of a batch culture dynamic_fba: A batch culture of the E. coli core model, which needs the extra metabolism.
    • Dynamic multi-species metabolic model dynamic_multispecies_fba: Two E. coli core strains that differ in maximal glucose uptake on one medium, which needs the extra.
    • Harvesting farmers harvesting: A socio-ecological model of farmer agents harvesting a logistically regrowing resource.
    • Model predictive control of Duffing, Van der Pol, and a bilinear DC motor through Koopman surrogates koopman_model_predictive_control: A plant that a discrete-time controller steers with model predictive control on a fitted surrogate.
    • Multiscale tumour angiogenesis tumour_angiogenesis: A tumour that outgrows its oxygen supply and recruits new blood vessels from a parent vessel.
    • Pheromone foraging pheromone_foraging: Ants that find food and lay a pheromone trail home, which other ants follow: stigmergy.
    • Regulatory flux balance analysis regulatory_fba: A batch culture on glucose and acetate with Boolean catabolite repression, which needs the extra.
    • Stigmergic predator-prey automaton stigmergic_predator_prey: Plants, prey, and predators on a grid, whose animals share emotions through decaying marks.

    coagulation

    • Coagulation cascade amplified by positive feedback and bounded by fibrinolysis coagulation_positive_feedback: The coagulation cascade, an all-or-nothing burst of thrombin bounded by protein C and fibrinolysis.

    coarsening

    • Allen-Cahn non-conserved relaxation (Model A) allen_cahn: The Allen-Cahn equation, Model A, the non-conserved relaxation of an order parameter in a double well.
    • Cahn-Hilliard phase separation (Model B) cahn_hilliard: The Cahn-Hilliard equation, Model B, the conserved relaxation of an order parameter in a double well.

    codimension two

    • Takens-Bogdanov takens_bogdanov_form: The Takens-Bogdanov normal form x' = y, y' = β1 + β2 x + x² + s x y, where a saddle-node meets a Hopf.

    coevolution

    • Solé-Manrubia extinctions sole_manrubia: The ecosystem of Solé and Manrubia, whose species go extinct when their dependencies turn against them.
    • Tangled Nature tangled_nature: The Tangled Nature model, where organisms whose types interact through random couplings coevolve.

    cognition

    • Cognitive consistency agents cognitive_consistency: Agents whose attitudes spread by conversation and settle in a belief network that seeks consistency.

    cohesion

    • Grégoire-Chaté cohesive flocks gregoire_chate: The Grégoire-Chaté model: aligning particles that also attract and repel, forming cohesive flocks.

    collapse

    • Keller-Segel chemotaxis keller_segel: The Keller-Segel model of cells that diffuse and climb the gradient of a chemical they secrete.

    collective decision

    • Binary ant decision binary_ant_decision: Ants that choose between two equal branches to a food source, following the marks of earlier ants.
